Concretely, crystal is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any voyage approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
